**Migrated 36 `db.query` calls across 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.** All files pass `node --check`.

Two callers left on the old form, on purpose:

| File | Why |
|---|---|
| [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) | Vendored copy, header says do not edit |
| `cache.query` in 20 repo files | Different API, not `db` |

`db.query` is still defined in [lib/db.js:13](lib/db.js:13). Drop it once the vendor bump lands.
